QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] The Blessing Returned, But...
QuestInfo.0:
The leader of Tisk Island, #bTomo#k, has something to say. 
Has the Wind Blessing returned?
QuestInfo.1:
The Wind Blessing of Tisk Island has returned.

However, it never came from the power of the ancient god, as most believe. It is actually a primitive spell born from the collective prayer of the island's residents. The residents continue to worship the god, happily oblivious to this fact...
QuestInfo.2: Isn't a blessing something to appreciate, regardless of its source? Let everyone be happy in their own beliefs and enjoy their tranquil island lives.
